As tossing continues, the airborne set rearranges, with some balls passing near the top edge.
caption: The video captures a man in a dark long-sleeved top, filmed from a low angle against a clear blue sky, juggling several red-white-and-blue basketballs with star patterns and lettering. His head stays tilted upward toward the balls as they rise and fall along arcing paths and shift across the sky. His hands alternately open to catch a descending ball and push upward to toss it, moving between a low cradling pose and a raised throwing pose. The ball in his screen-right hand is held for a long stretch before being set upward, while his screen-left hand keeps a low ball cradled near the lower edge. The airborne set changes arrangement as the action proceeds, with some balls passing near the top edge. The routine remains underway, with the airborne balls continuing their arcs.
